author: Christopher 'Suggsey' Smith
text: I was doing okay still even with 2+ I’m getting signal losses even when the phones close/on me. This newest sensors dropped signal randomly 4-6 times in two days. Still not anywhere near the claimed 6 metre Bluetooth range. I do wear a Garmin Instinct 2 Solar watch which is also connected to an iPhone 15 Pro and that’s always had a stable connection so it’s not the phone. Never had an issue either with Bluetooth headphones or speakers.

author: Brenda Dalton
text: When they work, they are absolutely brilliant. However, I have experienced several failures with only 2 in 5 lasting as long as they should. The techknowlegery  needs to be improved.

author: Barrie Linch
text: Brenda Dalton I do agree that the techknowlegery needs to be improved but I'm sure they will do that. In the meantime, it's still very good.
